About Me

I'm a Creative Group Head based in Mumbai with a lifelong obsession for design in all its forms — graphic, packaging, branding, and especially the subtle, powerful art of typography.

For 14+ years, I've been at the intersection of ideas and execution — at agencies like FCBULKA and L&K Saatchi & Saatchi, working across some of India's most iconic brands.

I believe great design isn't just seen — it's felt. Every piece I make chases that one idea that stops the scroll and stays in memory.
